teaser.en: A crunchy orange root from far away, whose English name came along with it into Digo.
teaser.sw: Mzizi wa rangi ya machungwa unaokatika kwa mkwaruzo, kutoka mbali, ambao jina lake la Kiingereza liliingia nao katika Kidigo.

summary.en: Karoti is the carrot, an introduced root vegetable whose Digo name comes from English. Pakia gives it as an example of a borrowed plant name that is likely to stay in the language.
summary.sw: Karoti ni mboga ya mzizi iliyoletwa ambayo jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na Kiingereza. Pakia anaitoa kama mfano wa jina la mmea lililoazimwa ambalo lina uwezekano wa kubaki katika lugha.

about.en: The carrot is grown for its thick orange taproot. Above ground it has a rosette of finely divided, feathery leaves. If left to grow into a second season, it sends up a tall stalk with flat umbrella-shaped clusters of tiny white flowers, typical of its family, which also includes coriander and parsley.
about.sw: Karoti hupandwa kwa ajili ya mzizi wake mnene wa rangi ya machungwa. Juu ya ardhi ina shada la majani yaliyogawanyika kwa wembamba kama manyoya. Ikiachwa kukua hadi msimu wa pili, hutoa shina refu lenye vishada bapa vya umbo la mwavuli vya maua madogo sana meupe, jambo la kawaida kwa familia yake, ambayo pia inajumuisha giligilani na parsley.

where.en: Carrots prefer cool weather and loose, deep soil, and most of Kenya's crop is grown in the highlands. At the coast they are mostly found in markets and shops, along with some home gardens.
where.sw: Karoti hupenda hali ya baridi na udongo usioshikamana na wenye kina, na sehemu kubwa ya zao la Kenya hupandwa nyanda za juu. Pwani hupatikana zaidi sokoni na madukani, pamoja na baadhi ya bustani za nyumbani.

uses.en: The root is eaten raw or cooked in stews, rice dishes and salads, and is valued as a source of vitamin A.
uses.sw: Mzizi huliwa mbichi au hupikwa katika mchuzi, vyakula vya wali na saladi, na huthaminiwa kama chanzo cha vitamini A.

culture.en: Pakia lists *karoti* among the names of introduced plants that are part of daily life and so are 'likely to stay and be stabilised' in Digo.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *karoti* miongoni mwa majina ya mimea iliyoletwa ambayo ni sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku, na kwa hivyo 'yana uwezekano wa kubaki na kutulia' katika Kidigo.

names.en: Digo: *karoti*. In Pakia's table of loaned plant names it is spelt *Karuti* and traced to English 'carrot'. The Swahili name is also *karoti*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *karoti*. Katika jedwali la Pakia la majina ya mimea yaliyoazimwa, limeandikwa *Karuti* na kufuatiliwa hadi Kiingereza 'carrot'. Jina la Kiswahili pia ni *karoti*.

reason.en: Cabbage, another introduced vegetable with a loan name
reason.sw: Kabichi, mboga nyingine iliyoletwa yenye jina la mkopo

reason.en: Irish potato, another introduced root crop
reason.sw: Viazi, zao jingine la mizizi lililoletwa
Nyanya, mboga nyingine ya bustani iliyoletwa
